inputChecks.pointer: Canvas pointer events produced judgments at varied tap coordinates.
inputChecks.space: One Space press produced one judgment and did not continue the run.
inputChecks.enter: One Enter press produced the next single judgment and did not continue the run.
inputChecks.restartTap: A canvas tap after the 700 ms guard reset the run to judged=0 and score=0.

promises.claim: A screen tap or one Space/Enter press launches one upward compression wave, independent of input position.
promises.observed: Canvas pointer clicks launched waves from varied coordinates. One Space produced exactly one first judgment and one Enter exactly one second judgment; neither key continued playing automatically.

promises.claim: The winning strategy is to tap when the white prediction marker reaches the white center line.
promises.observed: The first-play capture visibly aligns a bright circular marker with the white line and says '예측점을 흰 선에 탭'. Marker-timed pointer sessions reached precise results in every profile.

promises.claim: The first run teaches tap-to-wave, marker-at-white timing, and the 12 drops/3 ruptures end rule on screen.
promises.observed: The first-play capture simultaneously shows '탭 → 파동', '예측점이 흰 선일 때', and '12개 · 파열 3회 종료'.

promises.claim: Precise, hit, and fail are named and have materially distinct gel reactions.
promises.observed: Actual captures distinguish 정밀 with symmetric white rings and fragments, 성공 with asymmetric crimson separation, and 실패 with a vertical tear plus orange crack and named cause.

promises.claim: Twelve judgments or three failures end the run, and a screen tap after the protection window starts a fresh run.
promises.observed: The keyboard/idle path ended at three failures. After 800 ms, an actual canvas tap changed the debug state from over=true to over=false, judged=0, score=0.

promises.claim: No input ends at about 18 seconds after three ruptures and does not survive beyond one quarter of the 12-drop run.
promises.observed: The no-input browser run ended with judged=3, failures=3, score=0 at tick 1155; survivedFraction was exactly 0.25, not greater than 0.25.

promises.claim: The result screen shows the final counts, a directional correction clue, and a full-screen restart instruction.
promises.observed: The game-over capture visibly shows 끝, 정밀 1/12 · 파열 3/3, 다음: 조금 늦게 탭, and 화면을 탭해 재시작.

promises.claim: Audio remains unopened before user input and starts only after gameplay input.
promises.observed: The idle run finished with audioStarted=false. The Space input changed audioStarted from false to true, consistent with smoke-result.json.

strategyLegibility.winningStrategy: Tap anywhere when the white prediction marker meets the white center line.
strategyLegibility.taughtBy: Persistent first-three-drop text, a three-line first-run guide, visible marker/center-line alignment, and a directional game-over clue.

gradeLadder.shownBy: Actual play captures: symmetric white rupture for precise, asymmetric crimson split for hit, and vertical tear with orange cracks and a named cause for fail.

idleRun.note: No input ended at 3/12 judgments with 3/3 failures and audio still locked; the fraction equals the permitted boundary and does not exceed 0.25.

summary.ko: 통과. 화면의 흰 예측점과 중앙선만으로 승리 전략을 읽을 수 있고, 정밀·성공·실패의 이름과 젤 반응이 실제 캡처에서 구분된다. 포인터, Space, Enter, 종료 후 화면 탭 재시작을 실제 입력으로 확인했으며 키보드는 자동 해결하지 않았다. 무입력 생존 분율은 경계값 0.25이고 치명적 간극은 없다.
summary.en: Pass. The white prediction marker and center line make the winning strategy legible, and the named precise, hit, and fail states have distinct gel reactions in the actual captures. Pointer, Space, Enter, and post-game screen-tap restart paths were exercised; keyboard input does not auto-solve. Idle survival is exactly the 0.25 boundary, with no fatal gaps.
